title: Half of a ready room says they saw the cubes and spheres after the NYT article
summary: Ryan Graves tells of Half of a ready room says they saw the cubes and spheres after the NYT article, about after the New York Times article at Off the US East Coast (Roosevelt, 2014 to 2015), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says that his squadron saw strange objects, which he calls "cubes and spheres," while flying off the US East Coast around 2014 and 2015. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that after a New York Times article about these sightings came out, he asked pilots in a ready room, the briefing room where pilots gather, in a different area, and about half raised their hands to say they had seen them too. If true, it would mean the sightings were far more common than one squadron.
